identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: The name of this feature in the form 'namespace_name:feature_name'. 'feature_name' must match the filename.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Condition for placing associated Feature. If omitted, always places.

anyOf.title: Conditional Features
anyOf.description: Array of features, and their associated conditions, for attempted placement. These features will be evaluated as ordered.

early_out_scheme.title: Early Out Scheme"<"condition Success", "placement Success", "none"
early_out_scheme.description: Denote whether placement should end on first successful placement ('placement_success'), first passed condition ('condition_success'), or evaluate all features ('none'). Defaults to 'none'.
